reason: Start separating the water by collecting hydrogen at the electrolyzer outlet.
expectation: The electrolyzer will split water and make hydrogen available, perhaps leaving oxygen to collect separately.

alternatives.reason: Capturing carbon dioxide also meets a goal, but I want to start with water separation.

effect: Hydrogen is available; I still need oxygen to finish separating water.
reaction: The result is expected, though it gives little detail about the process.
reason: Collect oxygen from the other outlet to complete the separation goal.
expectation: An oxygen supply will be created and the water separation goal may be completed.

effect: Both gases are now available and the separation goal is complete; carbon dioxide remains.
reaction: The two outlet actions felt straightforward but a little repetitive.
reason: The receiver at the capture unit is the only gameplay option and matches the remaining goal.
expectation: The receiver will collect compressed carbon dioxide, completing that goal.

effect: The receiver supplied compressed carbon dioxide and completed the chapter; I understand these supplies are being prepared for the lander, though their later use is not yet shown.
reaction: The completion came sooner than I expected, leaving me curious about how the gases become propellant.

mostWorthwhile.text: Collecting hydrogen and oxygen made the water-splitting premise concrete, and connected a familiar substance to the return journey.

leastWorthwhile.text: The separate outlet actions felt repetitive: each simply created a named supply without explaining the operation further.

surprise.text: I expected further processing after carbon dioxide capture, so the chapter ending immediately surprised me.

arbitrary.text: The individual actions had clear purposes, but directing drinking water to each output outlet separately felt like a game convention rather than a clear physical procedure.

continue.text: Yes, I would try another chapter to see how these supplies contribute to the return, though I hope for more explanation and decisions than this short sequence provided.
